name.title: Camera Name
name.description: The name shown in Homebridge logs.

videoSource.title: Video Source
videoSource.description: FFmpeg input arguments for your camera. Use the input format, device path or network URL supported by your operating system and camera.

token.title: Prusa Connect Token
token.description: 20-character camera token. New tokens must be used within 15 minutes. Keep an existing camera’s fingerprint.

fingerprint.title: Camera Fingerprint (leave blank to generate automatically)
fingerprint.description: Keep the existing value when upgrading. For a new camera, leave blank to generate an identity saved in Homebridge storage. Include that storage in your backups.

snapshotInterval.title: Snapshot Interval (seconds)
snapshotInterval.description: How often snapshots are uploaded to Prusa Connect.

rebroadcastEnabled.title: Enable Video Rebroadcasting [Experimental]
rebroadcastEnabled.description: Lets this plugin own the camera and expose an MJPEG stream and snapshot URL for other plugins to use. Recommended if another plugin also needs camera access. Stream URLs are unauthenticated: use only on a trusted LAN, never forward this port to the internet.

streamFrameRate.title: Rebroadcast Stream Frame Rate
streamFrameRate.description: Frames per second for the rebroadcast MJPEG stream. Ignored in MJPEG passthrough mode.

streamQuality.title: Rebroadcast Stream Quality (1-10)
streamQuality.description: Higher is better image quality and higher bandwidth. Ignored in MJPEG passthrough mode.

snapshotUploadLimitSec.title: Rebroadcast Snapshot Upload Limit (seconds)
snapshotUploadLimitSec.description: Only upload from the rebroadcast buffer if the latest frame is newer than this many seconds.

ffmpegPath.title: FFmpeg executable
ffmpegPath.description: Executable name or full path to FFmpeg, accessible to the Homebridge process.
